<a id="page-nodes"></a>
# Node types

Every node type, generated from its declaration (`Widgets.all`). For each: what it is (with the Flutter widget it
corresponds to, when its declaration names one), how it takes children, and every prop with its JSON type,
default, allowed values and description. Props go under the node's `"props"` key; a key not listed here is
reported by validation (`unknown_prop`). The types link to [value types, models and enums](values.md).

"Reads from each child's layout" lists the placement fields the type reads ([layout](layout.md)): a child
of a stack is placed by `x` and `y`, a child of a row or column by `flex`, `squeezable` and `align`.

<a id="node-canvas"></a>
## `canvas`

Flutter `Scaffold`.

A screen (`Scaffold`): its `body` slot is the page content.

- Children: slots: `body`, `appBar`, `floatingActionButton`, `bottomNavigationBar`.
- Decoration: box decoration (fills, strokes, radius, shadows, clip).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scaleMode` | [ScaleMode](values.md#enum-ScaleMode) | `"responsive"` | `responsive`, `autoScale` |  |
| `blockBack` | bool | `false` |  | While true, going back (the system or browser back button, a back gesture) keeps the user on this screen and runs its `backPressed` reactions instead. Usually bound (`${= dirty}`). A navigate pop from the screen's own actions is never blocked. |
| `breakpoint` | String | `""` |  | The breakpoint it is the design for. |
| `screen` | String | `""` |  | The screen it is a breakpoint of. |
| `breakpointMinWidth` | double | unset | ≥ 0 | Its own switch point. |
| `overlay` | bool | `false` |  | Shown above every screen, outside navigation. |
| `backdrop` | bool | `false` |  | Drawn beneath every screen, outside navigation. |

<a id="node-stack"></a>
## `stack`

Flutter `Stack`.

A freeform container: children placed by `layout.x`/`layout.y` (Flutter `Stack` with `Positioned`/`Align` children).

- Children: `children`.
- Decoration: box decoration (fills, strokes, radius, shadows, clip).
- Reads from each child's layout: [`x`](layout.md#layout-x), [`y`](layout.md#layout-y).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scrollable` | bool | `false` |  | Scrolls its content. |
| `scrollDirection` | [Axis](values.md#enum-Axis) | `"vertical"` | `horizontal`, `vertical` | The axis it scrolls along. |
| `reverse` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `physics` | [ScrollPhysicsType](values.md#enum-ScrollPhysicsType) | `"platform"` | `platform`, `bouncing`, `clamping`, `never`, `rangeMaintaining` |  |
| `alwaysScroll` | bool | `false` |  | Scrolls even when the content fits. |
| `clipBehavior` | [Clip](values.md#enum-Clip) | `"hardEdge"` | `none`, `hardEdge`, `antiAlias`, `antiAliasWithSaveLayer` |  |
| `fit` | [BoxFit](values.md#enum-BoxFit) | unset | `fill`, `contain`, `cover`, `fitWidth`, `fitHeight`, `none`, `scaleDown` | Scale the board (its design size) into the box: contain, cover, scaleDown... |
| `fitAlignment` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) | `[0,0]` |  | Where a `fit` board sits in its box. |

<a id="node-row"></a>
## `row`

Flutter `Row`.

`Row` and `Column`: the same props, different main axis.

- Children: `children`.
- Decoration: box decoration (fills, strokes, radius, shadows, clip).
- Reads from each child's layout: [`flex`](layout.md#layout-flex), [`squeezable`](layout.md#layout-squeezable), [`align`](layout.md#layout-align).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mainAxisAlignment` | [MainAxisAlignment](values.md#enum-MainAxisAlignment) | `"start"` | `start`, `end`, `center`, `spaceBetween`, `spaceAround`, `spaceEvenly` |  |
| `crossAxisAlignment` | [CrossAxisAlignment](values.md#enum-CrossAxisAlignment) | `"center"` | `start`, `end`, `center`, `stretch`, `baseline` |  |
| `spacing` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | Space between children along the main axis. |
| `wrap` | bool | `false` |  | Wraps children onto new runs when they overflow (`Wrap`). |
| `runSpacing` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | Space between runs when wrapping. |
| `squeezeChildren` | bool | `true` |  | Children that overflow a bounded main axis shrink to fit it (by how far each can, never below its content), as the editor lays them out; false lays them out at their own sizes and lets them run past the end, as Flutter's `Row`/`Column` does. |
| `scrollable` | bool | `false` |  | Scrolls its content. |
| `scrollDirection` | [Axis](values.md#enum-Axis) | `"vertical"` | `horizontal`, `vertical` | The axis it scrolls along. |
| `reverse` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `physics` | [ScrollPhysicsType](values.md#enum-ScrollPhysicsType) | `"platform"` | `platform`, `bouncing`, `clamping`, `never`, `rangeMaintaining` |  |
| `alwaysScroll` | bool | `false` |  | Scrolls even when the content fits. |
| `clipBehavior` | [Clip](values.md#enum-Clip) | `"hardEdge"` | `none`, `hardEdge`, `antiAlias`, `antiAliasWithSaveLayer` |  |
| `fillViewport` | bool | `false` |  | A scrolling row/column's content is at least as long as its viewport (`ConstrainedBox(minHeight: viewport)` in a `SingleChildScrollView`): alignment and expanded children use the whole viewport while it fits. Already so when it centers or spreads its children or has a flex child; this makes it so in every case. |

<a id="node-variance"></a>
## `variance`

Variant switcher.

Shows one of several variants of its content (by id, or by breakpoint).

- Children: `children`.
- Decoration: box decoration (fills, strokes, radius, shadows, clip).
- Reads from each child's layout: [`x`](layout.md#layout-x), [`y`](layout.md#layout-y).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variants` | List<Object> | `[]` |  | `[{"id", "name", "children": `ids`, "breakpoint"?, "overrides"?}]`; `breakpoint` is a project `Breakpoint.id` (DESIGN.md §5.3): a variance with any is responsive. |
| `current` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `minWidths` | Map<String, double> | `{}` |  | Its own switch points, by breakpoint. |

| `physics` | [ScrollPhysicsType](values.md#enum-ScrollPhysicsType) | `"platform"` | `platform`, `bouncing`, `clamping`, `never`, `rangeMaintaining` |  |
| `alwaysScroll` | bool | `true` |  | Scrolls even when the content fits (`AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics`). |
| `primary` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `keyboardDismissBehavior` | [KeyboardDismissBehavior](values.md#enum-KeyboardDismissBehavior) | `"manual"` | `manual`, `onDrag` |  |
| `clipBehavior` | [Clip](values.md#enum-Clip) | `"hardEdge"` | `none`, `hardEdge`, `antiAlias`, `antiAliasWithSaveLayer` |  |
| `itemCount` | int | unset |  | The number of items; null repeats the item without end (or one per value of the bound `data`). |
| `cacheExtent` | double | unset | ≥ 0 |  |
| `query` | Object | `{}` |  | Where the items come from in a running app: a cloud query (`{"collectionPath", "limit", "whereFilters", "orderByFilters", "paging", "loadRelated", "statusVariable"}`). Runtime only. |
| `scrollable` | bool | `true` |  | False builds every item without a viewport when the count is known and the list hugs its items (or stretches them across a cross axis it hugs). |
| `itemExtent` | double | unset | ≥ 0 | Each item's extent along the scroll direction. |
| `separator` | [ListSeparator](values.md#enum-ListSeparator) | `"none"` | `none`, `space`, `divider` |  |
| `spacing` | double | `0` |  | The separator's extent; negative overlaps the items. Without a `separator` it is empty space (as a row's or column's spacing). |
| `dividerThickness` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `dividerColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#FF000000"` |  |  |
| `dividerIndent` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `dividerEndIndent` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `layout` | [ListLayout](values.md#enum-ListLayout) | `"list"` | `list`, `stack`, `deck` |  |
| `reversePaintOrder` | bool | `false` |  | Paints a layered list's items in the opposite order. |

| `runSpacing` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `wrapAlignment` | [WrapAlignment](values.md#enum-WrapAlignment) | `"start"` | `start`, `end`, `center`, `spaceBetween`, `spaceAround`, `spaceEvenly` |  |
| `wrapCrossAlignment` | [WrapCrossAlignment](values.md#enum-WrapCrossAlignment) | `"start"` | `start`, `end`, `center` |  |
| `stretchItems` | bool | `false` |  | Every item as thick across the list as the thickest beside it. |
| `pagination` | [Pagination](values.md#type-Pagination) | unset |  | Loads the items page by page, with pull to refresh (its footers are the `loading`, `error` and `end` slots). |
| `reorder` | [ListReorder](values.md#type-ListReorder) | unset |  | Lets the user drag the items to a new place. |
| `sections` | [ListSections](values.md#type-ListSections) | unset |  | Groups the items under headers (the `sectionHeader` slot). |

The current page is at rest, pages between are interpolated by their distance (clamped to two pages) and pages before are mirrored (`translateX`, `shiftX`, `rotate`, `rotateY` and the alignment's x change sign). A `Pose`: a transform with an opacity and a blur. Null: flat pages. |

Interpolated by distance like `pageMotion` and not mirrored. Null: `pageMotion` mirrored. |

Taps reach the page on top first. |

<a id="node-tableView"></a>
## `tableView`

Flutter `TableView`; its slots are the cell templates.

Flutter's `TableView` (two_dimensional_scrollables): a table that scrolls on both axes, with a header row and column that stay pinned. Rows are the bound `data` (or `rowCount`); columns are `columns` (or bound `props.columns`). Its slots are templates built per cell with `${item}`: `cell` (`{value, row, column, rowIndex, columnIndex}`), `columnHeader` (`{label, column, columnIndex}`), `rowHeader` (`{row, rowIndex}`) and `corner`.

- Children: slots: `cell`, `columnHeader`, `rowHeader`, `corner`.
- Decoration: box decoration (fills, strokes, radius, shadows, clip).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | List<[TableColumn](values.md#type-TableColumn)> | `[]` |  |  |
| `rowCount` | int | unset |  | The rows when no data is bound. |
| `rowHeight` | double | `40` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `rowHeightKey` | String | `""` |  | The field of a row (a map) that holds its own height, for rows that aren't all as tall (a summary row that grows with its content); rows without a number there are `rowHeight` tall. Empty: every row is. |
| `headerHeight` | double | `44` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `columnWidth` | double | `120` | ≥ 0 | A column's width unless it sets its own. |
| `rowHeaderWidth` | double | `120` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `fillWidth` | bool | `false` |  | Body columns grow to share the width the table has beyond all its columns' widths (equally), so a week fills a wide screen and still scrolls on a narrow one; no column is ever narrower than its width. |
| `pinHeaderRow` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `pinHeaderColumn` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `gridLineColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#FFE0E2E8"` |  | The lines between cells; transparent for none. |
| `gridLineWidth` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `stripeColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | Every other body row's background. |
| `headerColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | The header row's and column's background. |
| `cacheExtent` | double | unset | ≥ 0 |  |
| `clipBehavior` | [Clip](values.md#enum-Clip) | `"hardEdge"` | `none`, `hardEdge`, `antiAlias`, `antiAliasWithSaveLayer` |  |
| `horizontalPadding` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | Space before the first column and after the last. |
| `headerBorderColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | A line under the header row only. |
| `headerBorderWidth` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `rowHoverColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | A body row's background while the pointer is over it. |
| `selectedRow` | int | `-1` |  | The selected body row (bind it), -1 for none: drawn in `selectedRowColor` with a `selectedRowEdgeWidth` edge at its start in `selectedRowEdgeColor`. |
| `selectedRowColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `selectedRowEdgeColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `selectedRowEdgeWidth` | double | `4` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `stretchLastColumn` | bool | `false` |  | The last column takes the width the columns leave over, so the ruled rows run to the table's edge. |

| `tooltipLabelStyle` | [TextStyle](values.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` |  | The tooltip at `selectedX`: its first line (the x, small) and the y value (bigger, bold), each merged over its default. |
| `tooltipValueStyle` | [TextStyle](values.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` |  |  |
| `tooltipLabelField` | String | `""` |  | The tooltip's first line: this row field, else the x (`tooltipXFormat` for dates). |
| `selectedX` | double | unset |  | The point (nearest x) with the cursor and tooltip; null for none. |
| `scrubEnabled` | bool | `false` |  | Hovering or dragging selects the nearest point in a running app. |
| `scrubStep` | double | `1` |  |  |
| `tooltipXFormat` | String | `"h:mm a"` |  |  |
| `tooltipYScale` | double | `1` |  |  |
| `tooltipYDecimals` | int | `1` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `tooltipYSuffix` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `tooltipTrend` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `semanticLabel` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `bands` | List<Object> | `[]` |  | Full-height bands: `[{"from", "to", "color", "opacity"?}]`. |
| `yTicks` | List<Object> | `[]` |  | Horizontal grid lines: `[{"y", "label"?, "color"?, "align"?: "start"}]`. |
| `areaBands` | List<Object> | `[]` |  | Parts of the area under the curve: `[{"from", "to", "below", "color", "barColor"?}]`. |
| `referenceLines` | List<Object> | `[]` |  | Dashed horizontal lines: `[{"y", "color"?, "width"?, "dash"?: [on, off], "label"?, "labelColor"?, "labelBelow"?, "labelAlign"?: "end" \| "start"}]`; a label sits at the line's end (or start, with labelAlign "start"), above the line unless labelBelow, in `axisLabelStyle` (bold, the line's color unless labelColor). |
| `xTicks` | List<Object> | `[]` |  | X axis ticks: `[{"x", "label"}]`. |
| `markers` | List<Object> | `[]` |  | Circles on points: `[{"x", "y", "label"?, "filled"?, "above"?, "color"?, "radius"?, ...}]`. |
| `verticalLines` | List<Object> | `[]` |  | Dashed vertical lines: `[{"x", "color"?, "dash"?, "label"?, "dotOnCurve"?, "dotColor"?}]`. |
| `animateIn` | bool | `false` |  | Draws in (rising from zero) when it first shows (a running app). |
| `clip` | bool | `true` |  | Clips the chart to its box; off, labels (a reference line's above the plot) and out-of-domain values can draw beyond it. |
| `xLabelAnchor` | [LineChartXLabelAnchor](values.md#enum-LineChartXLabelAnchor) | `"edgeClamped"` | `edgeClamped`, `start`, `center`, `end` | Where each x label sits about its tick (`xLabelOffset` then moves it). |
| `xLabelOffset` | double | `0` |  | Moves every x label right by this much (negative: left). |
| `animate` | bool | `true` |  | Animates numeric data changes; initial and design-canvas values rest. |
| `animationDuration` | int | `700` | ≥ 0 | Milliseconds. Zero applies data changes immediately. |

<a id="node-barcode"></a>
## `barcode`

Barcode / QR code.

A barcode or QR code of `data`, filling the box.

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `symbology` | [BarcodeSymbology](values.md#enum-BarcodeSymbology) | `"qrCode"` | `qrCode`, `pdf417`, `code128`, `aztec`, `dataMatrix`, `ean13` |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#FF000000"` |  |  |
| `backgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `errorCorrection` | [BarcodeErrorCorrection](values.md#enum-BarcodeErrorCorrection) | `"medium"` | `low`, `medium`, `quartile`, `high` |  |
| `drawText` | bool | `true` |  | 1D codes: the text under the bars. |
| `overlap` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | Pixels each dark bar and module reaches past its right and bottom edge, so neighbours overlap: no hairline seams where anti-aliased edges meet, and a small ink gain (as `canvas.drawRect` codes widen bars to hide seams). 0 draws the exact geometry. |

<a id="node-path"></a>
## `path`

Flutter `CustomPaint` of an SVG path.

An SVG path, filled and stroked with the node's decoration (Flutter `CustomPaint`).

- Children: none.
- Decoration: box decoration (fills, strokes, radius, shadows, clip).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | String | `""` |  | SVG path data (`M0 0 L10 10 Z`). |
| `viewBox` | [Size](values.md#type-Size) | unset |  | The coordinate space of `data`, `[width, height]`, scaled to the box. Null: `data` is in the box's own pixels. |
| `scaleStroke` | bool | `false` |  | Whether the stroke (its width and dash lengths) is in `viewBox` units, scaled with the drawing as in SVG, instead of the box's pixels (an icon's line keeps its weight at any size; a diagram's grows with it). |
| `trimStart` | double | `0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | The stroked part of the path, as fractions of its length. |
| `trimEnd` | double | `1` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 |  |
| `strokeJoin` | [StrokeJoin](values.md#enum-StrokeJoin) | `"miter"` | `miter`, `round`, `bevel` | How segments meet when stroked (`Paint.strokeJoin`). |
| `subpathColors` | List<[Color](values.md#type-Color)> | `[]` |  | Colors of the path's shapes, one per closed subpath (`M ... Z`) in drawing order, repeating when shorter; a subpath inside the previous shape's bounds (a hole) belongs to it. They replace the solid fills' color (keeping each fill's opacity); null keeps the fill's color. |

<a id="node-video"></a>
## `video`

`VideoPlayer`. Its changed trigger reports ready/error and, when ready, durationSeconds/positionSeconds without autoplay; with reportIntervalMs, also positionSeconds/playing while it plays.

A network video (`video_player`'s `VideoPlayer`).

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | String | `""` |  | A remote HTTPS MP4, WebM, MOV or M4V URL. |
| `autoPlay` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `showControls` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `playing` | bool | unset |  | Null leaves playback to the built-in controls. Bind or set explicitly to play/pause from application actions; browser gesture rules still apply. |
| `positionSeconds` | double | unset | ≥ 0 | Absolute source-media time in seconds; null leaves the current time alone. |
| `volume` | double | `1` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 |  |
| `loop` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `fit` | [BoxFit](values.md#enum-BoxFit) | `"contain"` | `fill`, `contain`, `cover`, `fitWidth`, `fitHeight`, `none`, `scaleDown` | How the picture fills the node (`FittedBox`): `contain` letterboxes, `cover` fills and crops. |
| `poster` | String | `""` |  | An image URL shown until the video has its first frame (and while a new source loads), instead of a spinner. |
| `syncTolerance` | double | `0.3` | ≥ 0 | While playing, a changed `positionSeconds` seeks only when the video is more than this many seconds away from it, so a position bound to a running clock corrects drift instead of stalling the video with a seek every frame. Paused, every change seeks (the latest one wins). |
| `reportIntervalMs` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | While playing, fires the changed trigger every this many milliseconds with `positionSeconds` and `playing` (0: off): the video as a clock. |
